questions.prompt: As of 2023, how many women die from pregnancy- or childbirth-related causes for every 100,000 live births, worldwide?

source.name: WHO, UNICEF, UNFPA, World Bank Group, UNDESA

questions.insight: The global maternal mortality ratio has fallen by more than 40% since 2000, though it remains far higher in some regions than others.

questions.prompt: As of 2024, what percentage of the world's ocean and coastal area is within officially documented protected or conserved areas?
questions.insight: Only about 8% of the ocean is formally protected, and just a fraction of that is effectively managed, far short of the 2030 target.

questions.prompt: In 2023, on average, what percentage of GDP did the world's governments spend on education?
questions.insight: Global education spending has slipped from a 2020 peak of about 4.3% of GDP to 3.6%, below UNESCO's recommended 4-6% benchmark.

questions.prompt: As of 2023, what percentage of the world's population is under age 15?
questions.insight: Children under 15 made up about 37% of humanity in 1970; falling birth rates have brought that down to roughly a quarter today.

questions.prompt: What share of new cars sold worldwide in 2024 were electric (battery-electric plus plug-in hybrid)?
questions.insight: More than 1 in 5 new cars sold globally in 2024 was electric, up from under 5% just five years earlier.
